parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame is the main structural body of the cabinet, made of plywood. It provides the overall shape and support for the doors and base.
parts.Functional_description: It supports all other parts of the cabinet, including the doors and base, and maintains the cabinet’s rigidity and alignment.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that provides structural stability.

parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet base is the bottom support structure of the cabinet, made of plywood. It ensures the cabinet stands level and supports the weight of stored items.
parts.Functional_description: It distributes the load of the cabinet evenly and provides a stable foundation to prevent tipping or sagging.
parts.Movement_description: It is a stationary part that does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Cabinet Door (Right)
parts.Basic_description: The right cabinet door is a solid wood panel attached to the frame with hinges, allowing access to the cabinet interior.
parts.Functional_description: It opens and closes to provide access to the storage space inside the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Door (Left)
parts.Basic_description: The left cabinet door is a solid wood panel similar to the right door, hinged to the frame for access to the cabinet interior.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the left side of the cabinet’s storage area and closes to conceal contents.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close.
